title: Agent tokens
description: Scoped credentials for agents using MCP. At most 10 active tokens.

empty.title: No agent tokens yet
empty.description: Create a token to connect an agent.

mint.title: Create an agent token
mint.description: Choose only the scopes and resources your agent needs, and select an expiry.
mint.usageHint: Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token> to /mcp. Store it securely; it is shown only once.

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.protocol: Supports MCP 2026-07-28 and stateless 2025-06-18. Live client verification is pending.
connect.oauth: Use OAuth to sign in and approve each connected app, or configure a token:
connect.token: Set WSSP_AGENT_TOKEN to your agent token in your local environment. For OAuth with Codex, run: codex mcp login wssp.

apps.title: Connected apps
apps.ownOnly: Only sandboxes created by this app
apps.allSandboxes: May access your other sandboxes within its resource grants
apps.revokeDescription: Revoke this app’s grant and refresh tokens. It must ask you again before accessing resources.

consent.title: Allow agent access?
consent.description: {{client}} is requesting access to your account.
consent.subset: Select the requested permissions you want to allow. Unselected permissions will not be granted.
consent.hostWarning: The daemon user is an Incus admin. Host commands and host file tools can reach every sandbox on the node, including other users’ sandboxes in shared pools. “Own sandboxes only” does not limit host access. Host access also requires the setting to be enabled on the node.
consent.offline: Allow access while you are away (offline_access)
consent.invalid: This authorization request could not be completed. Start again from your agent.

login.sessionCheckFailed: We couldn't check whether you're signed in. Check your connection and try again.
login.title: Connect to MCP
login.description: Sign in to review the access requested by {{client}}.
login.reauthHint: If you revoked this app, sign out and sign in again to approve a new grant.
login.reauthenticate: Sign out and sign in again
login.reauthFailed: Could not sign out. Your session is unchanged. Try again.

host.title: Agent access
host.terminal: People may open a host terminal
host.enableAtNode: Run the daemon as a service and turn on from a separate local login on the node. The direct dashboard host terminal is refused by the local gate.
host.confirmDescription: This blocks access immediately and keeps the dashboard block until you choose Allow again. The node receives a turn-off request now or when it reconnects. Processes started outside the daemon process tree, such as cron jobs and systemd user units, are not stopped.
host.failed: Could not change dashboard access. Try again.
host.vetoed: Blocked by the dashboard. This block stays in place until you allow access again.
host.liftDescription: This only lifts the dashboard block. The node setting must still be turned on in a local login session on the node. Allowing again does not turn it on.
host.liftUnavailable: Allow again requires the node to be online and report this setting off. Run {{command}} at the node first, then wait for its off report.
host.tamperWarning: Something on the node turned it back on. The dashboard block still refuses access and keeps sending the turn-off request. Investigate the node and revoke its credential if needed. Run {{command}} at the node before allowing access again.
host.keepDescription: This adds a dashboard block: even if someone turns the setting on at the node, access stays refused until you choose Allow again.
host.keepOffHint: Already off at the node. This adds a dashboard block, so it stays refused even if someone turns it on at the node.

queue.title: Queued commands
queue.hint: Agents can request commands on your node. Review the command and reason before deciding. Run marks the request as handed off; it does not prove execution.
queue.failed: Could not decide this command. Refresh and try again.
queue.reviewHint: Inspect the complete wrapper. After you connect the terminal, it is pre-typed once without a newline. Press Enter only when you are ready to run it.
queue.copyHint: Automatic pre-typing is unavailable. Copy the wrapper and review it before running it in your own host terminal.
queue.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the wrapper manually.

audit.title: Recent host audit
audit.unavailable: Host audit is unavailable. Retry to load recent activity.

revoke.description: Requests with this token fail from now on. Work it already started is not cancelled.
revoke.typePrompt: Type the token name to confirm

expiry.warning: This token remains active until you revoke it, or until the operator stops allowing no-expiry tokens. Store it securely.
expiry.limit: Dated tokens must expire within {{days}} days.
expiry.invalid: Choose a future expiry within the allowed date range.
expiry.blockedByPolicy: Blocked by policy: this server no longer allows tokens without an expiry, so this token is refused. It is not revoked and works again if the operator allows no-expiry tokens. Create a dated token to keep the agent working.

emptyActive.title: No active agent tokens
emptyActive.description: Your revoked tokens are hidden. Choose Include revoked to see them.
